content.introduction: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, process, and disclose your information, including personal information, in conjunction with your access to and use of our platform.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.text: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make a purchase, or contact us for support. This may include your name, email address, phone number, and payment information.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.text: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process transactions, send you technical notices and support messages, and respond to your comments and questions.

sections.title: Information Sharing

sections.title: Data Security

sections.title: Your Rights

hero.title: Cookie Policy
hero.description: This policy explains how we use cookies and similar technologies to recognize you when you visit our platform.

content.introduction: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are and how we use them on our platform. You should read this policy to understand what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can control them.

sections.title: What Are Cookies
sections.text: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide information to website owners.

sections.title: How We Use Cookies
sections.text: We use cookies for several reasons. Some cookies are required for technical reasons for our platform to operate, and we refer to these as 'essential' cookies. Other cookies enable us to track and target the interests of our users.

sections.title: Types of Cookies We Use
sections.text:
Essential Cookies: Required for the platform to function properly.
Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our platform.
Functional Cookies: Enable enhanced functionality and personalization.
Advertising Cookies: Used to make advertising messages more relevant to you.

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
sections.text: In addition to our own cookies, we may also use various third-party cookies to report usage statistics, deliver advertisements, and so forth. These cookies are subject to the respective privacy policies of the third parties.

sections.title: Managing Cookies
sections.text: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings preferences. However, if you limit the ability of websites to set cookies, you may impact your overall user experience.

sections.title: Cookie Duration
sections.text:
Session Cookies: These are temporary and are deleted when you close your browser.
Persistent Cookies: These remain on your device for a set period or until you delete them.

contact.title: More Information
contact.text: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at cookies@range4ex.com or through our contact page.

meta.description: Learn about our commitment to GDPR compliance and your data protection rights.

hero.title: GDPR Compliance
hero.description: We are committed to protecting your personal data and respecting your privacy rights under the General Data Protection Regulation.

content.introduction: The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is a comprehensive data protection law in the European Union. This page explains how we comply with GDPR and outlines your rights as a data subject.

sections.title: Data Controller
sections.text: We act as the data controller for the personal data we collect and process. This means we determine the purposes and means of processing your personal data and are responsible for ensuring compliance with data protection laws.

sections.title: Legal Basis for Processing
sections.text:
We process personal data based on one or more of the following legal grounds:
• Consent: You have given clear consent for us to process your data.
• Contract: Processing is necessary for a contract with you.
• Legal Obligation: Processing is necessary to comply with the law.
• Legitimate Interest: Processing is necessary for our legitimate business interests.

sections.title: Your Rights Under GDPR
sections.text:
As a data subject, you have the following rights:
• Right to Access: Request copies of your personal data.
• Right to Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate data.
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data.
• Right to Restrict Processing: Request limitation of processing.
• Right to Data Portability: Request transfer of your data.
• Right to Object: Object to processing of your data.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.text: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including to satisfy legal, accounting, or reporting requirements.

sections.title: International Transfers
sections.text: When we transfer personal data outside the EEA, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, such as Standard Contractual Clauses or adequacy decisions by the European Commission.

sections.title: Data Protection Officer
sections.text: We have appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) to oversee our data protection strategy and implementation. You can contact our DPO for any GDPR-related inquiries.

sections.title: Data Breach Notification
sections.text: In the event of a personal data breach, we will notify the relevant supervisory authority within 72 hours where feasible. If the breach is likely to result in a high risk to your rights and freedoms, we will also notify you directly.

contact.title: Exercise Your Rights
contact.text: To exercise any of your GDPR rights or if you have any questions about our data protection practices, please contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@range4ex.com or through our contact page.
